confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer estimates use Kyoto-wide cost-of-living prices last updated in May 2026. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated relative to local beer using a limited local menu check. Accommodation anchors are non-live estimates and vary substantially by season and area.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Kyoto citywide prices. Osaka and other major Japanese tourist cities provide a broad sanity check for the holistic accommodation estimates.
